# Historical evidence synthesis: CREATE TABLE DDL formatting

## Coverage and citation convention

This audit covers the supplied reports and inventory for **batch 1 of 1, 30 source files**: H0060–H0064, H0074–H0075, H0110–H0115, H0119, H0206–H0220, and H0248. Both supplied chunks for H0112 and H0119 are considered together. File counts include copies, reviews, guidance traces, and successive rounds; they are **not counts of independent trials**. Original task wording and individual formal evaluation cases are generally unavailable.

Citations give the original source ID, a path suffix relative to `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/`, and exact reported event IDs. All cited events are `main_agent` events unless otherwise stated. Formal scores are inventory metadata, not independently inspected evaluation outputs.

## Evidence matrix

| Source and original path suffix | Observed work and validation | Outcome and limit |
|---|---|---|
| **H0061**, `runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane5/codex_parallel_05_lane5_H_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | A standalone DDL extractor was created; formatting was explicitly unimplemented. Two extraction examples and a SELECT were checked; 1,228 existing tests passed. A malformed combined formatting/commit request was rejected before execution (events 41–50, 52). | Nonempty partial patch; inventory **20/32 fail-to-pass**, **1,273/1,273 pass-to-pass**, formally unsolved. A commit is not evidenced. |
| **H0062**, `runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane5/codex_parallel_05_lane5_I_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | Inspected dispatch and reproduced unchanged output; no edit or write attempt visible. The student claimed read-only permissions (events 1–13). | Zero-byte patch, **0/32**, **1,273/1,273**, formally unsolved. Permission denial was not independently observed. |
| **H0074**, `runs/codex_parallel_07/lanes/codex_parallel_07_lane5/codex_parallel_07_lane5_H_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | Added a model and renderer after the existing safety check; fixed an import syntax error and obtained a formatted, idempotent example. A background pytest run had no visible result (events 25–44, 47–50). | Nonempty patch; `CancelledError` and incomplete session. **Formal evaluation unknown**, not a demonstrated failure or success. |
| **H0110**, `runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane5/codex_parallel_08_lane5_B_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/trajs.json` | Committed a post-safety-check formatter. Simple and nested examples were idempotent, but a quoted semicolon caused a parsing error; a functional run stopped at 53 passes and one fixture failure before the final guard edit (events 23–26, 30, 34, 37–38, 45–48). | Executed partial implementation with an observed input-specific failure; formal evaluation missing. Fixture correctness under the unseen requirements is uncertain. |
| **H0112**, `runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane5/codex_parallel_08_lane5_H_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | Added an early special-formatting return, model and parser; examples were idempotent, 1,099 unit tests passed before later edits, and commit `8120657` was observed (events 43–48, 51–56, 59–67). | Inventory says **solved: 32/32 and 1,273/1,273**. The student nevertheless reported incomplete scope, including comments, templates, multiple statements and line-length enforcement. Formal acceptance is not proof of broader quality. |
| **H0114**, `runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane5/codex_parallel_08_lane5_I_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | Committed a standalone formatter and later lexical comparison; one unit run passed 1,099 tests, while another had one failure. A legacy functional fixture still differed; two CLI cases passed on rerun. A malformed call was recoverable (events 19–26, 34–40, 42–56). | **28/32 and 1,273/1,273**, formally unsolved. Full suites shown predate the final safety commit; causes of formal failures are unknown. |
| **H0206–H0207, H0210–H0211, H0214–H0215, H0218–H0219**, respectively `runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane5/codex_parallel_12_lane5_{B_r1,B_r2,H_r1,H_r2,I_r1,I_r2,M_r2,M_r3}/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | These traces show exploration and baseline reproduction but no visible implementation; branch creation was observed, for example H0210 events 4, 9 and H0219 events 4, 9. Some baseline assertions or imports failed, e.g. H0210 events 44–45. | Each inventory records a zero-byte patch, **0/32 and 1,273/1,273**, formally unsolved. Normal end turns do not establish algorithm failure or explain why work stopped. Rounds are not independent samples by default. |
| **H0248**, `preflight/parallel_13_fixes/real_sqlfmt/preflight13_sqlfmt_B_r1/infer_logs/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/turn_1/trajs.json` | Committed a formatter and DDL model with a separate lexical equivalence check; corrected one comparison-spacing example. The final focused run reported 177 passes, while 1,099 unit passes preceded later changes (events 42, 47, 50, 53–63, 78–81). | **30/32 and 1,271/1,273**, formally unsolved. Four individual evaluation failures are unidentified; their causes cannot be assigned. |

## Cross-case interpretation

**Observed behavior versus hypotheses.** Several students reproduced unchanged CREATE TABLE output and inspected a body represented as an opaque `DATA` token: H0061 events 25–26 and 39–40; H0112 events 5–6 and 37–38; H0206 events 24–25. In H0206, a separate CORE-only probe produced individual tokens (events 63–64). This supports a task-specific dispatch and representation boundary for those examples, not a complete explanation of every dialect or formal failure.

The transferable distinction is between diagnosing a baseline, changing a user-facing path, and validating the final change. H0061’s passing regression suite and extractor smoke tests did not establish formatting integration. Conversely, H0112’s formal pass is a real recorded acceptance despite the student’s stated limitations; neither result justifies a universal claim about standalone approaches. H0110’s quoted-semicolon error is directly observed, whereas H0063’s proposed `<` delimiter-stack failure is a **teacher hypothesis**, not a tested case (H0063, `runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane5/codex_parallel_05_lane5_M/reviews/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/round_1/teacher/trajs.json`, event 3). H0074’s lowercased identifiers are observed, but semantic harm in a relevant dialect remains unverified (events 47–48).

Safety-check placement is another observed boundary rather than proof of unsafety: H0074 and H0110 transform after the existing check; H0112 returns before the normal analyzer and check; H0114 adds a different lexical comparison. Their different outcomes do not establish causal superiority. Tests and idempotence checks cover the inputs and revisions actually run, not all comments, templates, nested expressions, line limits or dialect variants.

**Stops differ.** H0062 reported a permission constraint without a visible denial. H0206 and the other listed parallel-12 empty-patch traces created branches but ended without source changes; their reasons are unknown. H0061’s rejected tool input prevented the requested combined command from running, while H0114 recovered from a malformed call. H0074 was actually interrupted with cancellation. These should not be merged with an executed algorithm’s observed failure, such as H0110’s quoted-semicolon error.

## Teacher roles and evidence limits

Guidance creation is directly visible in **H0064**, `runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane5/codex_parallel_05_lane5_shared/hint_gen/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/trajs.json`, events 33–35, and **H0220**, `runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane5/codex_parallel_12_lane5_shared/hint_gen/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/trajs.json`, events 29–31. Teachers inspected architecture and reference diffs and wrote guidance; reading a reference diff was not applying it, and successful guidance-session completion was not formatter validation. H0075, H0115 and H0119 similarly document guidance rather than student implementations.

Reviewers separately diagnosed reported attempts and sometimes labeled hint use “partially used.” For example, **H0060**, `runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane5/codex_parallel_05_lane5_H/reviews/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/round_1/teacher/trajs.json`, event 5, describes the extractor and missing formatter integration; **H0111**, `runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane5/codex_parallel_08_lane5_H/reviews/sqlfmt-create-table-ddl-formatting/round_1/teacher/trajs.json`, event 5, reports architectural divergence and a line-length limitation. These are reviewer accounts, not substitutes for direct student events. H0113, H0208–H0209, H0212–H0213 and H0216–H0217 likewise contain review judgments and reported student work; they do not independently prove the cause of stopping.

Available hint paths do not establish delivery. H0114 records one teacher check but supplies no delivered teacher text; H0062, H0214 and H0215 report zero checks. No supplied student observation establishes actual receipt and causal adoption of the quoted guidance. Overlap between a suggestion and subsequent investigation is consistent with adoption but also with independent task exploration. After-round reviews are not input to that same round; no later execution of their corrective advice is shown.

## Scope and remaining uncertainty

This is a software-only batch: there is no Scene artifact, visual acceptance, or independent assessment of objects, materials, pose, camera, lighting or render quality. Missing formal scores are **unknown**, not failures or successes. Some parallel-12 and preflight inventory entries contain usage counts, but absent older usage records do not imply zero calls or recoverable historical model cost. This synthesis is audit-only; it does not establish causal superiority or supply new solutions, skills or test feedback.
